oneOf.title: convert
oneOf.description: Convert an amount from a base currency to a quote currency with rate lookup and calculated result (e.g. convert $169 USD to VND).

amount.description: Amount of base currency to convert (e.g. 169.0).

date.description: Optional specific historical date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. '2024-01-15'). Defaults to latest rates.

oneOf.title: batch_convert
oneOf.description: Convert a single base amount into multiple quote target currencies in a single API call (e.g. convert 100 USD to EUR, GBP, JPY, and VND simultaneously).

action.description: Action discriminator for batch multi-currency conversion.

targets.description: List of target quote currency ISO codes (e.g. ['EUR', 'GBP', 'JPY', 'VND']).

amount.description: Amount of base currency to convert across all target currencies.

oneOf.title: historical_trend
oneOf.description: Query historical exchange rate performance over a date range or relative preset ('7d', '30d', '90d', '1y', 'ytd') and calculate summary statistics (min, max, avg, % change).

action.description: Action discriminator for historical FX analytics.

from_date.description: Start of date range in YYYY-MM-DD format (overrides relative period preset if to_date is also set).

to_date.description: End of date range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

group.description: Optional time grouping for downsampling rates ('week' or 'month').

oneOf.title: search_currencies
oneOf.description: Search active or legacy ISO currency codes, currency names, symbols, and central bank data providers.

action.description: Action discriminator for currency metadata search.

query.description: Optional search term to filter currency codes, names, or symbols (e.g. 'Dong', 'VND', 'Yen').

scope.description: Set to 'all' to include historical legacy currencies.
